title: Vib Event Staffing
subtitle: Website Design and Development
details:
I crafted Vib a vibrant and dynamic website that mirrors their commitment to excellence in event services.

Collaborating directly with the business owner, we designed a site that highlights their top-tier staff and unique service offerings. The playful, yet professional design captures the personality of the brand and presents an easy-to-navigate platform for booking services and exploring event options.
